description: Read the public change feed of the MCP directory, oldest first: listings updated or removed and issues reported, acknowledged, fixed, declined, reopened or closed. Events carry ids, statuses and counts only. Pass after with the previous next_cursor to continue; optionally filter by server_id.

after.description: Cursor from the previous next_cursor; 0 starts at the oldest retained event

server_id.description: Only events for this directory listing id
